data.name: CommandOpen
data.comment: 頂層命令那一列上的動作標籤:按下去只是進到那一頁。

data.name: CommandNewNote
data.comment: 清單頁 Ctrl+K 選單裡的「新增筆記」(Ctrl+N)。不帶「Inkling:」前綴 —— 那是頂層命令用來自報家門的,在自己的選單裡是雜訊。

data.name: CommandCapture
data.comment: 快速記下那一列的動作,也當作那一區的標題。

data.name: CommandOpenFileLocationSubtitle
data.value: Select this file in File Explorer

data.name: ProviderCaptureSubtitle
data.value: Type to save a note; the body goes after the separator
data.comment: 刻意不寫出實際的分隔符:那是可以改的設定,而頂層命令的副標不會跟著更新。也刻意不放 alias 的提示:副標永遠顯示,而 alias 只需要學一次,而且這個命令沒有 alias 照樣能用(選中按 Enter 就進去了)—— 那件事寫在 README。

data.name: ProviderNewNoteSubtitle
data.value: Open a form for longer notes

data.name: ProviderScratchpadSubtitle
data.value: Pick up where you left off, no title needed

data.name: ScratchpadDiscard
data.comment: 草稿板底部工具列的第一顆(Enter)。刻意不叫 Done —— 這一頁存檔會自己關掉面板,所以按到這一顆的意思是「這次打的不存」。講「變更」而不是「草稿」:被丟掉的是這一次的編輯,不是已經存在檔案裡的草稿。

data.name: ScratchpadSaved
data.comment: 存完就關面板,所以走的是會關面板的 toast(CommandResult.ShowToast),不是 InfoBadge —— 後者畫在面板上,面板收了就看不見。

data.name: ScratchpadDiscarded
data.comment: toast 是一瞥的東西,一行就要讀完 —— 曾經在後面接「存著的草稿沒有動」,實機看過就知道太長。要保住的區分(丟掉的是這一次的編輯,不是檔案裡的草稿)由中文的「這次的」帶,英文 discarded 的受詞是 changes 已經隱含。同一個區別見 ScratchpadDiscard。

data.name: ProviderDeleteSubtitle
data.value: Delete a few, or clear them all

data.name: ListPageEmptySubtitle
data.comment: {0} 是快速記下那個頂層命令的標題(ProviderCapturePageTitle),兩邊自動保持一致。

data.name: ListPageNoMatchTitle
data.comment: 查詢沒有命中時的空白提示。CmdPal 的 ShowEmptyContent 不看搜尋框有沒有字,所以「有筆記但搜不到」也會走到這裡 —— 不能說「還沒有任何筆記」。

data.name: ListPageNoMatchSubtitle
data.value: Try different words, or press Enter to capture a new note instead
data.comment: 空白提示那一列的命令就是快速記下頁,Enter 會導覽過去。

data.name: ListPageMoreResults
data.comment: {0} 是被截掉的筆記數。

data.name: ListPageMoreResultsSubtitle
data.value: Type a bit more to narrow it down

data.name: ListPageSkippedFilesSubtitle
data.value: Still in the folder — another program has them open, or they are not UTF-8

data.name: ToggleSourceShowRaw
data.comment: 講的是「按下去之後會看到什麼」,不是目前的狀態。

data.name: ToggleSourceSubtitle
data.value: Select and copy raw Markdown without opening the preview

data.name: ToggleSourcePageSubtitle
data.value: Exactly what the file holds — indentation, HTML and SVG included

data.name: NoBody

data.name: NoBodyPlain
data.comment: 同一句話的純文字版,給預覽頁的原始文字模式用 —— 那個檢視器不解析 Markdown,底線會照字面印出來。

data.comment: {0} 是資料夾路徑。打錯一個字就靜靜換了資料夾,看起來會像舊筆記全部消失,所以要當場講。

data.name: SettingNotesDirectoryDescription
data.value: Put it under a cloud drive such as OneDrive and let that handle multi-device sync — Inkling does not sync anything itself. Changing the folder does not move notes you have already written; it only points Inkling at the new location. Use a full path — a folder that does not exist yet is created on first save. Clear the field to go back to the default folder.
data.comment: 會進 Adaptive Cards 的 TextBlock,它只認得粗體/斜體/清單/連結 —— 反引號會照字面印出來,引用一律用引號。

data.name: SettingSeparatorDescription
data.value: In quick capture, whatever you type before it becomes the title and the rest becomes the body. The default “;;” needs no Shift and is fastest to double-tap, and two semicolons in a row never turn up in ordinary prose, so a single semicolon stays free inside titles. If you often write notes containing for (;;), switch to “,,” — same key positions, even fewer collisions. Half-width and full-width count as the same: set “;;” and typing “；；” still splits.
data.comment: 同上,反引號會照字面印出來,引用一律用引號。

data.name: SettingPreviewDescription

data.comment: 只寫「按下去會發生什麼」;取捨的理由屬於 README,不是設定頁。

data.name: CommandRetry
